The Doors's "Gloria" reached #71 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Gloria" is a rock song written by Northern Irish singer-songwriter Van Morrison.

The song peaked at #71 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 7 weeks on the chart.

Gloria was released in 1983.

"Gloria" is a rock song written by Northern Irish singer-songwriter Van Morrison.
Conceived in 1963, it was recorded with his band Them in 1964, and released as the B-side of "Baby, Please Don't Go" that same year.
It received positive reviews and was moderately successful on release; it experienced commercial success in 1966, reaching number 71 on the Billboard Hot 100.
